newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI Plc offers up to 143 mln ICI shrs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI Plc offers up to 143 mln ICI shrs.

text.p: ICI Plc said on Monday it would offer 120 million to 143 million of its ICI Australia Ltd shares to the public and institutions, with 100 million of those shares to be offered in Australia.
ICI Plc said the retail offer would be capped at A$12.40 per share and would be offered at a 40 cent discount to the offer price for institutions.
The institutional offer price would be determined by reference to bids from institutions and would be announced on July 12.
ICI said the retail offer would open on June 25 and close on July 9.
The instutitional offer would open on July 1 and close on July 11, before the July 12 announcement of the final prices.

ICI Plc said that in addition to the global offering it had granted underwriters outside of Australia an over-allottment option of up to 12 million shares which, if excercised, would raise the maximum number of shares sold to 155 million.

"If the offering is completed at the largest size of 143 million shares, the exercise of the over-allotment option and the maximum buy-back would result in the sale by ICI Plc of its entire holding in ICI Australia," the British-based company said.

The joint lead managers in Australia are Goldman Sachs Australia and Macquarie Underwriting and co-lead managers are SBC Warburg Austrlia, BZW Australia, County Natwest Securities Australia, Merrill Lynch International (Australia), Ord Minnett Corporate Finance and J.B. Were & Sons.

ICI Plc said the offer would not be registered under the U.S. Securties Act and shares could not be sold or re-sold in the United States except in accordance with an available exemption from registration.
